impact: The README CLI section lists status, setup, update, tail, persona, compact but omits onboard. A new npm user has no way to discover they should seed their fingerprint.
resolution: Added 'zug onboard' to the README CLI section with description. Also documented 'zug compact' and 'zug persona' which were missing. README and printUsage() in cli.ts are now aligned.
title: zug onboard command not documented in README CLI section
